Hi Mina,

Following the SIA we opened regarding the partial service interruption on 2026-07-09, our security/compliance team needs the following to close our review:

- Latest Incident Response Plan (IRP) for Redwood Inference services that process PHI
- Consolidated timeline of actions taken during the incident (UTC timestamps preferred)
- A short forensic summary and any logs you can share (redacted if necessary)
- Contact for escalation and SOC 2 evidence links if available

Can you share these by EOD Monday 2026-07-12? If you cannot meet that date please provide an ETA. We may need these for our regulator submission.

Thanks,

Mina/Team,

Attached: forensic_summary_healthnet.pdf (redwood internal summary) — includes high level findings and recommended follow-up.
Also attaching incident_timeline_20260709.csv with UTC timestamps and action owner.

Notes:
- Root cause: cascading resource exhaustion on a multi-tenant routing service; mitigations included immediate routing failover and cache eviction.
- No evidence of data exfiltration; forensic team reviewed access logs for 24 hours prior and after the event.
- Logs: we can provide anonymized request logs and system metrics (retention 90 days). Raw audit logs require a secure transfer; see proposed transfer method below.

Proposed secure attachments: forensic_summary_healthnet.pdf, incident_timeline_20260709.csv.
For raw audit logs we recommend SFTP to Forensica (reports@forensica.io) under an NDA or secure share via our GCS signed URLs.

Ben

Hi all,

I pulled the timeline into the shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/IRP/healthnet-2026-07 (read-only link attached to packet).
A couple of clarifications:
- Timestamps in the CSV are UTC; human-readable timeline is at the top of the doc.
- We keep different log tiers: request logs (90 days), infra metrics (60 days), kernel traces (14 days). HealthNet requested "logs" broadly; please confirm which tiers they need.
- For regulator purposes we should include the IR plan PDF (redwood_ir_plan_v2.pdf) and the SOC 2 evidence pointer rather than dumping raw audit logs.

If HealthNet explicitly requests raw logs for a compliance investigation, we'll coordinate a secure transfer and an NDA amendment.
